pattern: (?s)^(?=.*(to-speech|speech synthesis|synthesi[sz]ed speech|vocoder|speech reconstruction|output_types=audio))(?=.*(bottleneck|autoencoder|deep feature loss|shared decoder|latent (space|target|alignment)|embedding (loss|alignment|matching)|spectral encoder))
inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize speech from a non-acoustic signal (articulography, ultrasound, video, EMG, neural recordings) and supervise the signal encoder during training with paired speech, either by direct spectral regression or by matching the latent of a speech encoder or autoencoder that is not used at test time. Boundary: exclude acoustic-input conversion, recognition-only studies and self-generated targets; count versions of one study once; the design of interest is the speech-latent (autoencoder bottleneck or deep feature) target.
